{{Top|leg}}
The '''Durability implant''' regulated the electrical current running through the body in such a way as to improve the wearer's stamina. In addition, there was a side-effect in the form of an increased resistance to energy-related attacks.

==Behind the scenes==
In the game, the playable character must have a constitution attribute of 14 or higher.
